_comment: Atlas Maharani — real table and column names, from the discovery run. Copy to config.json and fill in the two passwords.

items._comment: STOCKMST001 is the item master. BLOCK=1 means blocked, so those are skipped. MODIDATE lets us sync only what changed.
items.query: select itemcode, itemname, groupcode, subgroup, brand, company, DIVISION, HSNCODE, IGST, commonunit, Cprice, RPrice, Sprice, suppcode, MODIDATE from dbo.STOCKMST001 where itemname is not null and ltrim(rtrim(itemname)) <> '' and isnull(BLOCK,0) = 0
items.name: itemname

suppliers._comment: Suppliers are ledger accounts in the 170000 range — that is where every suppcode in PURCHASE001 falls. Confirm the column names before running.
suppliers.query: select acccode, accname, place, phone, gstno from dbo.ACCOUNTS001 where acccode between 170000 and 179999
suppliers.name: accname
